brand_voice_note: Warm, reverent, and quietly empowering - it speaks about the body with softness while reassuring you on safety, comfort, and reuse over waste.

concepts.primary_text:
Feels like a hug to the human body.

The Cheeky Brief moves with you through every hour - snug at the hips, soft against the skin, with up to 12 hours of protection you stop thinking about.

No leaks, even on heavy days. No bulk, no diaper-like feeling. Just you, feeling like yourself.
concepts.headline: Comfort that holds you all day
concepts.why_it_works: The boyshort's whole promise is all-day, body-skimming comfort, so leading with the single feeling of being held makes the desirable outcome the hero.
concepts.visual_direction: The mocha boyshort laid softly on a grey linen bedsheet in morning light, with a hand smoothing the fabric and a small dish of lavender alongside.

concepts.primary_text:
Light days shouldn't mean a drawer full of disposables.

The Hipster Brief handles light flow quietly, so you stay dry and comfortable all day - no bulk, no diaper-like feeling, no waste piling up.

One pair. Hundreds of disposables replaced. That's the whole point.
concepts.headline: Light flow, handled quietly
concepts.why_it_works: The hipster is built for lighter days, so naming the everyday friction of reaching for disposables and replacing it with one reusable pair fits the product perfectly.
concepts.visual_direction: The rose hipster brief laid flat on a folded sage towel on a stone bathroom counter, with a tea mug and eucalyptus alongside in soft daylight.

concepts.primary_text:
Worried leakproof underwear feels bulky and thick? This isn't that.

The Full Brief gives you generous, high-waisted coverage with a seamless finish that disappears under anything - no bulk, no diaper-like feeling.

A triple-layered leakproof lining absorbs 3-5 tampons worth of flow, and it's PFAS-free with OEKO-TEX certified fabric. Coverage you'll actually want to reach for.
concepts.headline: Full coverage that disappears
concepts.why_it_works: Full briefs carry the biggest 'this looks bulky under clothes' hesitation, so crushing that objection with the seamless finish and real absorbency stats is the strongest lever here.
concepts.visual_direction: The mocha full brief laid softly folded on an oak dresser beside folded grey trousers, lit to show how thin and seamless it is.
